clauses.reason: Original section 1(a)(ii) blocks the property of any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, after consultation with the Secretary of State, to meet listed criteria. Before the amendment, criterion (A) reached a political or military leader of a foreign armed group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo that impedes the disarmament, repatriation or resettlement of combatants, and criteria (C) and (D) reached leaders recruiting or using children in armed conflict and persons who committed serious violations of international law involving the targeting of children. After Executive Order 13671 restated subsection (a), the criteria read in its text: (A) impeding the disarmament, demobilization, voluntary repatriation, resettlement or reintegration of combatants by a foreign armed group leader, (B) the same for a Congolese armed group leader, (C) responsibility for or complicity in listed actions or policies in or in relation to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (threats to peace, security or stability, undermining democratic processes, targeting civilians, use or recruitment of children, obstruction of humanitarian assistance, attacks on peacekeepers, support through illicit trade in natural resources), (D) arms transfers and related assistance, (E) leadership of an entity engaged in those activities, (F) material support, and (G) ownership or control. The clause continues as amended.
